# R10 card art — card id ↔ generated file (art-r10/final/)

Style: v3 Coinly flat (locked 2026-11-17). Slice B wiring: copy each file to
`src/assets/cards/` under a clean name and register in `cardArt.ts` by card id.
`rec-tomato-egg-2` (duplicate data entry) reuses the rec-tomato-egg art;
rec-tomato-egg itself was wired in Slice A from the v3 proof.
